solution:
The correct answer is__** first high level programming language.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **FORTRAN**

 
 
• The full form of FORTRAN is the **FORmula TRANslation.**
 
• FORTRAN, created by **John Backus **in **1957**, is the very first high-level programming language.
 
• It is a programming language designed for numeric computation and scientific computing.
 
• Fortran is the** oldest programming language** and is still widely used.
 
• Its applications are found in the:
 
 
• scientific fields
 
• particularly numerical weather prediction
 
• computational fluid dynamics
 
• computational physics.
 
 
 
• Fortran is also quite popular in high-performance computing.
 
• It is used in **program benchmarking** and ranking the world's fastest supercomputers.
